spans.s: + आत्मन् केवल- + आत्मन्, m. being the absolute unity,

† केव् केव्, i. 1, Ātm. To serve.
 --Cf. खेव्, सेव्.

केवल, i. e. एके (old loc. sing. of एक) + वल,
 I. adj., f. ला (ved. ली).
 1. Exclusively proper; वीक्षस्व यद्रूपं मम केवलम्, Look what shape is proper only to me,

; nothing but, 3, 118.
 3. Alone, only, Pañc. v. d. 12.
 4. United, i. e. entire,

.
 II. लम्, adv.
 1. Only, Pañc. 31, 7.
 2. Entirely (?),
; न केवलम्--अपि, Not only, but also,

.
 III. n. The knowledge of the unity of all the universe.
 IV. m. The name of a prince. Bhāg.

.
 V. f. ली, The name of a locality,
केवलिन्, i. e. केवल + इन्, m. One who possesses the knowledge of the universal unity, Bhāg.
